criteria.evidence: Six of eight clauses hold; I re-verified each rather than inheriting it. CANONICAL OWNERSHIP: src/modules/directory/person-seam.ts resolves a PersonSubject through three named paths into one ResolvedPerson; the spine is composite-FK'd at every hop (src/db/schema/hr/core-people.ts:84-96, 152-165). SELF-VS-ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORIZATION — HOLDS, and I confirmed the ticket's own closed item rather than trusting it: `grep -n RequireModule src/modules/hr/onboarding/core/onboarding.controller.ts` returns NO MATCH, so the two `@RequireModule("hr")` decorators that 403'd every member of an HR-disabled org out of their own onboarding tasks are gone; and src/modules/rbac/permissions/role-defaults.ts:5 still carries `{ permissionKey: "self:onboarding-tasks", scope: "own" }` in the universal member grants, i.e. the grant is merged before any role is read, so the module gate really was the only thing denying them. TENANT-SCOPED SCHEMA AND INDEXES: check:tenant-indexes and check:tenant-relationships are exit 0 in GATE-STATUS.tsv — but see the blocker, verify:membership-revocation contradicts this clause on nine HR tables. BOUNDED SEARCH/LIST PROJECTIONS: GET /hr/employees is keyset-paginated with a projected select and search is capped twice over (EMPLOYEE_SEARCH_CAP plus a SECURITY DEFINER function pinned to app.current_org_id()); check:unbounded-reads and check:hr-pagination are exit 0. Residual, not a clause failure: `users.last_name` is still ILIKE'd in the fallback with no trigram index — `grep -rn 'idx_users_.*trgm' migrations/*.sql` returns idx_users_name_trgm, idx_users_email_trgm and idx_users_first_name_trgm and nothing on last_name (the two other last_name trgm indexes found are on `candidates` and `organization_people`). PRIVACY-SAFE CACHING: the employee-list key carries org + actor + DataScope + every filter. TANSTACK KEYS: tenancy is structural via scopedQueryKeyHashFn; check:query-scope exit 0 over 5,360 files.
criteria.blocker: THREE THINGS FAIL. (1) RESPONSIVE ACCESSIBILITY — NOT MET and NOT MEASURED. Two concrete defects are still present at head: features/hr/employees/skills-matrix-page.tsx:139-157 is the one hand-rolled `<table>` in HR and `grep -n 'scope=' ` on it returns nothing — no `scope="col"`/`scope="row"` on any `<th>`; and four HR sheets still set an unconditional fixed width that `sm:max-w-sm` clamps to 384px — features/hr/goals/create-goal-sheet.tsx:84 `w-[420px]`, features/hr/kpis/kpi-library-tab.tsx:191 `w-[420px]`, features/hr/kpis/competency-frameworks-tab.tsx:224 `w-[480px]`, features/hr/feedback/cycles-tab.tsx:229 `w-[480px]`. Coverage: my own enumeration of every axe-using test under frontend/ finds exactly ONE touching this territory, features/hr/dashboard/__tests__/hr-leave-calendar.test.tsx:121,127 (this REFUTES 07-audit.md's claim that 'of 23 a11y test files in the repo, none covers HR, Directory, Me or employee self-service' — one now does). Against 581 features/hr files, 19 features/directory files, 5 features/employee-self-service files and 138 HR/directory route pages, features/directory, features/employee-self-service and app/(authenticated)/me/** still have ZERO axe coverage, and no browser was ever driven at any viewport. (2) CROSS-TENANT E2E — structurally NOT PROVABLE by the harness that exists. test/helpers/e2e-app.ts:33-47 states it in its own header: 'Controller e2e specs assert the guard chain — 401 / 402 / 403 — and every one of those is thrown before the handler, so none of them needs a database', with MembershipStateService, EntitlementsService and AccessService all overridden to answer from the bearer token. No row ever exists, so no cross-tenant read is exercised by any of the 9 HR/directory *.e2e-spec.ts files. `find src test -name '*seeded-e2e-spec.ts'` returns 11 files (billing, crm x3, db, kb, perf, security x3, support) — NONE for hr or directory. And the suite cannot be run out of the box at all: `grep -c AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS .env` in the backend returns 0. (3) TENANT-SCOPED SCHEMA — a REAL VIOLATION measured by a gate. verify:membership-revocation is EXIT 1 with 12 FAILs, of which NINE are this ticket's tables (/tmp/beg-verify_membership-revocation.log): 'FAIL roster_entries declared=set-null but NO FK on [user_membership_id] references organization_members — nothing enforces it' (line 333 — the exact table and FK this ticket's migration 1052 claims to have landed; the declaration at src/db/schema/hr/rosters.ts:37 and migrations/1052_t07_roster_entries_natural_key.sql both exist and 1052 is journalled at _journal.json:4734, so this is declared-vs-live drift on the database the gate measured, not a missing migration file); 'FAIL performance_reviews declared=set-null actual=blocks-removal' (154); 'FAIL hr_mood_checkins declared=set-null actual=blocks-removal' (298); and six composite SET-NULL FKs with no column list that the gate says 'will 23502' because org_id is NOT NULL — hr_case_notes, hr_benefit_enrollments, hr_dependents, hr_insurance_claims (x2: user_membership and decider_membership), hr_travel_visit_logs (345-349, 384). Its summary is 'Inventory vs FKs: FAIL'. Separately, verify:multi-org-employment is EXIT 1 but is NOT a rule violation — /tmp/beg-verify_multi-org-employment.log fails at 'Error: [region] organisation 06161c5f-ae82-4a6e-b0e0-813bce6ee8d9 has no region. It must be placed before its data can be reached' out of RegionRegistry.resolvePlacement, i.e. the multi-org-employment rule was never actually checked; treat it as unarbitrated, never as a pass. Both gate logs also open with 'RLS is enabled but "neondb_owner" has BYPASSRLS, so every tenant policy is inert' — they ran as the owner. To close: fix the nine membership-revocation FAILs (or apply 1052 to the measured database), add axe + viewport coverage for HR/Directory/Me, and stand up a seeded cross-tenant HR e2e with APP_DATABASE_URL on a non-owner role.
criteria.clauses_failing: responsive accessibility; allow/deny/cross-tenant E2E (the cross-tenant half); tenant-scoped schema and indexes (verify:membership-revocation exit 1 on 9 HR tables)

criteria.evidence: SIX OF 07-audit.md's SEVEN P0/P1 FINDINGS ARE REFUTED AS FIXED AT HEAD — I checked each in the source rather than believing the report. F1 (P0, 'rupees added to cents in the payroll input snapshot'): the offending `totalAmount` expression no longer exists in payroll-inputs-build.service.ts; :376 now calls `buildReimbursementPayload(userId, reimbs, benefitClaims)` from the new src/modules/hr/payroll-inputs/payroll-inputs-money.ts:70-100, which passes reimbursement rupees through unchanged and converts claim minor units with `fromPaise(c.amountCents)` under a comment naming the 100x payout, summing in minor units; __tests__/payroll-inputs-build-guards.spec.ts:76-120 tests it with one reimbursement and one claim, exactly the case F17 said was untested. F3 ('the import's per-row error handler cannot run'): hr-import.service.ts:196-215 now wraps each row in `await tx.transaction(async (rowTx) => ...)` — a real savepoint — with a comment naming SQLSTATE 25P02. F4 ('attendance rate counts sessions, not days'): hr-dashboard-attendance.ts now uses `count(DISTINCT (attendance.userId, attendance.date)) FILTER (WHERE attendance.id IS NOT NULL)`, with the FILTER's purpose written down. F5 ('the attendance import's duplicate guard is dead code'): hr-import-commit.service.ts:212-235 replaced the unreachable onConflictDoNothing with an explicit `select` duplicate probe on (orgId, userId, date) and explains why a unique index cannot replace it. F6 ('payroll input build silently truncates at 1000'): `assertNotTruncated` now THROWS 'Refusing to write a partial period' above PAYROLL_INPUT_SCAN_CAP. F7 ('a third departmentId filter is accepted and discarded'): all three sites now thread it — hr-analytics-plus.service.ts getLeaveTrends, getComplianceGaps and `getDrilldown(orgId, metric, page, limit, departmentId)` all pass departmentId into their fetch helpers. MET CLAUSES: module/record/DataScope authorization (check:scope-application, check:record-access, check:module-gate, check:module-entitlement, check:authz-deny all exit 0 in GATE-STATUS.tsv); async exports (the HrExport worker's per-org claim cursor with the upload outside any transaction); frontend states (readErrorReachesBoundary is the default throwOnError and no HR hook opts out; 47 error.tsx under app/(authenticated)/hr/); folder cohesion (check:file-sizes and check:over-300 exit 0 on the frontend, no HR backend file over 500 lines).
criteria.blocker: FIVE CLAUSES STILL FAIL. (1) EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE SCHEMA — 07-audit F2's two invariants are STILL ABSENT at the database level. `grep -n 'uniqueIndex|unique('` on src/db/schema/hr/core-people.ts returns uniq_hr_people_org_id, uniq_hr_people_org_person_link (partial on organization_person_id, :85-87), uniq_hr_employments_org_id, uniq_hr_employments_org_id_person (on org_id+id+person_id — per-employment, not per-person), uniq_hr_employments_org_emp_num and uniq_hr_employments_org_engagement_link. There is NO `(org_id, person_id) WHERE is_primary AND deleted_at IS NULL` partial unique and NO `(org_id, user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL` unique, while core-people.ts:141 keeps `isPrimary: boolean("is_primary").default(true).notNull()`. The single-request path is now closed in the application — hr-employments.service.ts:205-240 probes for an existing live primary and creates the second employment as non-primary, with the duplicate-directory-row failure written into the comment — but that is a check-then-insert with no lock, so the concurrent path 07-audit named (person-employment-sync) is still unprotected and the canonical twin worker_engagements still carries the index this leg does not. (2) TENANT-COMPOSITE INTEGRITY — verify:membership-revocation EXIT 1, summary 'Inventory vs FKs: FAIL', with nine HR/directory FAILs including 'roster_entries declared=set-null but NO FK on [user_membership_id] references organization_members — nothing enforces it' and six composite SET-NULL FKs with no column list that will raise 23502 on membership removal (hr_case_notes, hr_benefit_enrollments, hr_dependents, hr_insurance_claims x2, hr_travel_visit_logs). See PRD-C118's blocker for the line numbers. (3) BOUNDED INDEXED QUERIES — 07-audit F8 is unchanged: `wc -l src/db/schema/hr/index.ts` is 51 lines and none of attendance-correction-links, attendance-projections, attendance-event-evidence, attendance-event-store, audit-events, workforce-legacy-maps, workforce-reconciliation, worker-leave-balance-projections or worker-leave-ledger is exported from it (grep count 0 for each), so their 16 tables sit in neither the drift gate's declared set nor the catalog and check:declaration-column-drift's 'declared-but-absent tables 0' is measured over a corpus that cannot see them — and that gate is itself exit 2 (INCONCLUSIVE) in GATE-STATUS.tsv. F13 also stands: users.last_name is the one searched name column with no trigram index. (4) CACHE INVALIDATION — both dead bumps and the unreached cache are STILL PRESENT: employee-onboarding.service.ts:433 `this.cache.invalidate('hr:salary-bands:${orgId}')` and :434 `hr:dashboard:payroll-summary:${orgId}` (the only other mention of hr:salary-bands repo-wide is a `cache.del` at hr-salary-structures.service.ts:87; hr:dashboard:payroll-summary has no reader at all), and celebrations.service.ts:47-48 still caches `hr:anniversary-feed:${orgId}:${actorUserId}:${scope}:${today}` through plain `cached()` while the sibling at :136 uses cachedVersionedForOrg — no invalidation reaches it. (5) REPRESENTATIVE HR WORKFLOWS — NOT RUN and not runnable here. There is no seeded HR e2e (`find src test -name '*seeded-e2e-spec.ts'` = 11 files, none HR), the 9 HR/directory *.e2e-spec.ts run against the DB-less harness described in test/helpers/e2e-app.ts:33-47, and AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS is absent from the backend .env so they throw out of the box. Hire -> onboard -> attendance -> leave -> exit has never been exercised against real rows. To close: land the two partial uniques, fix the nine membership-revocation FAILs, export the nine HR schema files (or move them to a declared-pending folder), delete or wire the two dead bumps and move the anniversary feed onto the hr:celebrations namespace, and run a seeded HR workflow e2e on a non-owner APP_DATABASE_URL.
